purpose: If Gate010 and Gate011 both pass, test whether the adaptive 16-entry per-BitLinear clipping codebook adds value beyond the already-established Four-Over-Six principle of trying multiple token/block-local scales and selecting by quantization MSE.
entry_condition: Gate011 must pass its frozen adaptive-vs-absmean, adaptive-vs-absmax sanity, and absolute-viability rules on both WikiText-2 and C4. Otherwise do not run Gate012.

frozen_protocol.calibration_transfer: WikiText validation only; frozen unchanged for C4
frozen_protocol.data_construction: Exactly the Gate010/Gate011 first-16 prefixes of the previously frozen 32-sequence tensors.

two_scale_MSE_A4_definition.literature_mapping: Four Over Six evaluates two block-local scales, quantizes under both, and selects the representation with lower quantization MSE. Because the present comparator is signed INT4 rather than FP4 E2M1, this is explicitly a 4/6-inspired INT4 hostile control, not an implementation of NVFP4 Four Over Six.
two_scale_MSE_A4_definition.per_token_candidates: For each native BitLinear activation token x, let a=max(abs(x)). Candidate clip thresholds are c_full=a and c_shrunk=(2/3)*a, preserving the 4:6 range ratio of Four Over Six.
two_scale_MSE_A4_definition.quantizer: For each candidate c: scale=7/c; q=round(x*scale).clip(-8,7); x_hat=q/scale. Choose the candidate with lower full-vector mean squared reconstruction error for that token.
two_scale_MSE_A4_definition.selection_information: The two-scale choice is one binary selector in addition to the token-local base scale implied by absmax. Report this metadata distinction explicitly; do not call it rate-matched to the 4-bit fixed-codebook index unless a common scale-storage convention is implemented.
two_scale_MSE_A4_definition.selection_restrictions: Selection uses only the current activation tensor. No labels, logits, downstream loss, or evaluation-corpus tuning.

primary_rules.adaptive_beats_two_scale: On each corpus, adaptive-codebook A4 mean NLL < two-scale-MSE A4 mean NLL and the paired-bootstrap 95% upper CI of adaptive-minus-two-scale per-sequence NLL is < 0.
primary_rules.adaptive_beats_absmean_sanity: Gate011 adaptive-vs-absmean direction reproduces on identical slices within numerical tolerance.
primary_rules.absolute_viability: On each corpus, adaptive-codebook A4 NLL <= native A8 NLL + 0.50.
primary_rules.robust_pass: All three rules pass on both corpora.

secondary_ceiling.optional_only_if_primary_passes: After the primary frozen verdict is computed, a separately labeled non-rate-matched ceiling may evaluate the 13 candidate token-local clip fractions [0.40,0.45,...,1.00] by exact reconstruction MSE. It cannot alter the primary Gate012 pass/fail decision.
secondary_ceiling.interpretation: If the 16-entry calibration-derived codebook beats the two-scale hostile control but loses to the 13-way token-local ceiling, the remaining contribution is metadata/selection-structure efficiency rather than superior unconstrained distortion optimization.

interpretation_boundary.pass: Calibration-derived per-BitLinear scale dictionaries retain a quality advantage over both BitNet-v2-style absmean A4 and a direct Four-Over-Six-inspired token-local MSE scale selector at true BitLinear sites. This would justify larger/task-level evaluation, but not a broad novelty claim for adaptive MSE scale selection.
interpretation_boundary.fail: Stop the adaptive-codebook method claim. The surviving effect is explained by known adaptive scale-selection principles rather than the calibrated dictionary construction.
interpretation_boundary.shape_gain: Gate009 remains binding; do not reopen separately coded radius/shape-gain.

literature_boundary: Four Over Six (arXiv:2512.02010) evaluates two block-local FP4 scales and reports MSE selection as the best overall scale-selection rule; the present INT4 comparator is inspired by that mechanism, not equivalent to NVFP4.
BlockDialect (ICML 2025) already establishes online activation assignment from a small representation formatbook.
BitNet v2 already establishes native A4 for 1-bit LLMs with H-BitLinear and continue-training.
TWLA already establishes W1.58A4 PTQ using orthogonal shaping and mixed-precision activation allocation.
prohibitions: Do not run Gate012 if Gate011 fails.
Do not tune the 2/3 candidate ratio after evaluation.
Do not use downstream NLL to select token scales.
Do not call the 4/6-inspired INT4 control an implementation of NVFP4 Four Over Six.
Do not reopen A3/A2/A1 or shape-gain.
